I'm a robotics researcher and engineer, currently working for the [**Boston Dynamics AI Institute**](https://theaiinstitute.com) where I'm trying to make robots learn to do stuff by watching humans do said stuff. Previously, I spent time at [**Carnegie Mellon University**](https://www.cmu.edu/)'s [**Robotics Institute**](https://www.ri.cmu.edu/) where I made robots move around while looking at the right things around them. Eons ago, I studied electrical systems and computer science at the [**Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani**](https://www.bits-pilani.ac.in/Goa/).
